items.title: Foodlink F&B Holdings' ₹361 crore IPO to open for subscription on Nov 26
items.description:
Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) Ltd, a luxury food services company, is looking to raise Rs 361 crore through its maiden public offering, which will open for subscription on November 26, with a price band of Rs 181-191 per share.
The Initial Public Offering (IPO) will close on November 30, while bidding for anchor investors will take place on November 25, according to the public announcement on Monday.
The public issue comprises a fresh issue of equity shares aggregating up to Rs 192 crore and an Offer For Sale (OFS) of up to 88,35,382 equity shares worth Rs 168.76 crore by existing shareholders.
At the upper end of the price band, the total issue size works out to Rs 360.76 crore.
The company proposes to utilise the proceeds from the fresh issue towards setting up one new centralised kitchen and two new banquets, as per the RHP (Red Herring Prospectus).
A portion of the proceeds will also be invested in its material subsidiary, Foodlink Global Restaurants & Catering Services ...
